The '''Rotoksa Ridge Grand Lodge''' was a [[City/Legends|city]]-sized structure built in [[Sakiya]]'s [[Rotoksa Mountain Range]] out of stone and wood. It was surrounded by a collection of small buildings known as [[Ridgetown]]. The Lodge was the base for numerous [[Hunting/Legends|hunts]], which were a critical part of [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] culture.<ref name="LoNH" />

The Lodge overlooked the massive [[Hunter's Valley]], which was converted into a game preserve. [[Species/Legends|Species]] from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were brought to the valley and trapped by a [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shield]], so that they could be easily hunted.<ref name="LoNH" />
